name: loss of cooling
consequence: reduced heat removal; reactor temperature rises toward the trip

name: thermal runaway
consequence: temperature accelerates past the trip; relief and possible vessel damage

name: instrument fault or conflict
consequence: acting on a wrong reading; masked hazard or spurious intervention

cause: coolant flow low (pump degradation, valve restriction, fouled strainer)
effect: jacket heat removal drops; TT-101 rises steadily
same signature as flow loss but FT-201 normal; TT-101 rises slowly over shifts
FT-201 dips 10-15% and self-clears within ~2 min; not a true cooling loss

reason: defeating the high-temperature trip removes the last independent protection layer
adds heat generation while removal is already insufficient

plan: restore FC-201 to the previous setpoint and monitor TT-101 for 10 minutes
restore feed to the previous rate once TT-101 is back below alarm and stable
restart per SOP-RESTART after the cooling fault is cleared; expect ~4 h production loss
